function.name: list_files
function.description: List the files and folders in one folder of the project. Use this to discover existing configuration files and identify the project's current technology stack. Folders end with a slash.

path.description: Folder, relative to the project. Use . for the project folder.

function.name: read_file
function.description: Read a text file, especially project configuration files, dependency manifests, and documentation, to identify the existing technology stack and dependencies. A long file comes back in parts, and the reply says where the next part starts.

start.description: Where to start reading. Use the number from the previous reply.

function.name: create_file
function.description: Create a new file with the given content. Missing folders are created.

path.description: New file, relative to the project.

content.description: The whole content of the file.

function.name: edit_file
function.description: Replace one exact piece of text in a file. The text must appear exactly once.

new_text.description: The text to put in its place.

function.name: move_file
function.description: Move or rename a file. The destination must not exist.

source.description: File to move, relative to the project.

destination.description: New path, relative to the project.

function.name: delete_file
function.description: Delete one file. Folders cannot be deleted.

function.name: run_command
function.description: Run one command from the allowed list. The reply has the exit code and the output.

command.description: The whole command, exactly as in the allowed list.
